hints: Build the heap once, outside the loop. Rebuilding it every iteration is correct but throws away the whole point of the algorithm.
Each iteration: swap a[0] with a[end], then heapify the root over a SMALLER heap. The element you just parked at a[end] is finished.
The size argument to maxHeapify must be end, not n. Passing n drags the already-sorted tail back into the heap and the array never converges.
title: heapSort: sort by repeatedly evicting the root
